facts.fact: The APDP's 2015-2020 activity report states that Law no. 2017-20 of 20 April 2018 (the Code du numerique, Book V on personal data protection) was promulgated in April 2018, replacing the 2009 data protection law, and describes it as the legal framework the authority applies through 2020.
facts.system: Loi n° 2017-20 du 20 avril 2018 portant code du numérique en République du Bénin

facts.fact: The report states that Law no. 2009-09 of 22 May 2009 on the protection of personal data set the legal framework for personal data protection in Benin and created the CNIL, which is the law the 2018 Code du numerique later replaced.
facts.system: Loi n° 2009-09 du 22 mai 2009 portant protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: The report states that over 2016-2020 the APDP guided more than 500 controllers, ran control missions followed by awareness sessions nationwide, issued 5 declaration forms, and lists as a future aim the effective exercise of the control and sanction powers the Code du numerique gives it; no fine or sanction is recorded in the report.
facts.system: Loi n° 2017-20 du 20 avril 2018 portant code du numérique en République du Bénin

facts.fact: The report states that the CNIL's members were installed in October 2010 under the 2009 law, and that the APDP, created by article 462 of the Code du numerique, is run by a council of nine counsellors under a president whose second term ran from December 2015 to 16 December 2020, with the report listing the named members.
facts.system: Autorité de Protection des Données à caractère Personnel (APDP)

facts.fact: The report gives the APDP's own count of decisions rendered as 24 in 2016, 44 in 2017, 47 in 2018, 96 in 2019 and 136 in 2020 up to 15 December, 347 in all; the 2020 figure is 48 authorisations, 74 declarations, 8 opinions, 6 complaints and no self-referrals.
facts.system: Loi n° 2017-20 du 20 avril 2018 portant code du numérique en République du Bénin

facts.fact: The report's annex records the CNIL's deliberation no. 2016-001/AT/CNIL of 18 August 2016 refusing (defavorable) Spacetel Benin (MTN) authorisation to collect alphanumeric and biometric data to identify subscribers.
facts.system: Loi n° 2009-09 du 22 mai 2009 portant protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: The report's annex records deliberation no. 2016-014/AT/CNIL of 21 December 2016 on Etisalat Benin (Moov): collection of non-sensitive subscriber data approved, collection of biometric fingerprint data refused.
facts.system: Loi n° 2009-09 du 22 mai 2009 portant protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: The report's annex records an APDP opinion of 2020 against lifting anonymity on the Hepatitis B health status of employees of a company (BWSC), listed as defavorable; it also records in 2020 an injunction to a controller to guarantee a complainant's right of deletion.
facts.system: Loi n° 2017-20 du 20 avril 2018 portant code du numérique en République du Bénin
